title: Accuracy of transfer learning in predicting peri-implantitis onset from intraoral radiograph: A multi-center longitudinal retrospective study.
summary: 195 implants / 108 patients from Michigan and London; baseline radiographs and five pretrained CNNs/four transfer-learning strategies; non-hybrid feature extraction yielded best AUC 0.74–0.83 (InceptionV3 .83), while fine-tuning was lower. Retrospective, modest discrimination. The result is limited to this study setting and is not evidence of benefit in deployment.
